fixed.title: Fixes

fixed.title: Fixes
items: Reduced repeated cloud-shadow work and refined solar glare and flare.

fixed.title: Fixes
items: Fixed identified black-sky and bloom-copy failures and retained valid camera observations.

fixed.title: Fixes
items: Repaired space-sky objects, first-person shadows and liquid texture details.

fixed.title: Fixes
items: Kept custom skies clear of distance fog and improved Golden Hour clouds and sunlight.

fixed.title: Fixes
items: Repaired distorted lava geometry and retained Flat, Wavey and Off behavior.

fixed.title: Fixes
items: Improved player, equipment and orbit-view shadows, and leaf-lighting updates.

fixed.title: Fixes
items: Improved shadow-edge filtering and preserved sky selection without unnecessary redraws.

fixed.title: Fixes
items: Restored the preceding shader behavior after the 1.7.9 regression.

items: Adjusted shadow sampling and solar effects.

fixed.title: Fixes
items: Improved shadow transitions and player shadows.

items: Preserved saved 3D characters during profile changes and initial sign-in.
fixed.note: Introduction date not recorded; documented on November 13, 2026.

fixed.title: Homepage and profile chooser
items: Placed profile details and shortcuts directly above the profile chooser with a small gap.
Simplified the memory value to GB only.
Refined dropdown spacing and selection states, replacing the small profile arrow with a menu icon.

fixed.title: Selection and homepage layout
items: Moved profile information and shortcuts further down on Home.
Added gold outlines and full-row mouse and keyboard selection for profiles and accounts.
Replaced the three window-control symbols with matching centered icons.

fixed.title: Standard client and visual cleanup
items: Unified the normal mod catalog as Mods, removing EZ tags and the Premium switch.
Removed experimental Minecraft renderer selection and Minecraft shader-pack downloads from the standard client.
Matched the rounded profile chooser and Play button, strengthened the title and removed content dividers.
Added individual gold mod icons.

fixed.title: Homepage layout
items: Moved the Bloxdy Client title to the top of the home panel.
Aligned profile details and gave Edit profile and Browse mods matching buttons.

fixed.title: Launcher controls
items: Made dropdowns more compact and aligned menus with the complete field.
Removed the Play without mods button.

fixed.title: Launcher
items: Removed the description beneath the launcher title.

fixed.title: Zoomer settings spacing
items: Each setting now has its own bordered box with the same gaps as Bloxd settings.

fixed.title: Mod settings navigation
items: Switching categories clears the previous selection.
Mod settings reopen without an empty page.
Smooth wheel timing is disabled when smoothing is off.

fixed.title: Party Voice removed
items: Party Voice and its microphone access have been removed.

fixed.title: Zoom and character updates
items: Zoom transitions finish on time; instant wheel changes no longer bounce back.
Updated character textures and armour colors. Join a world to refresh an old white model.

fixed.title: Camera connection and loading errors
items: Updated Zoomer for the current game cameras.
Zoom resets when the game loses focus.
Failed page loads show Retry instead of a blank window.

fixed.title: Zoom release and mouse wheel
items: Releasing V restores normal zoom; small wheel movements are recognized.

fixed.title: Account portraits
items: Improved head size, accessories, and centering.

fixed.title: Grassify improvements
items: Reduced gaps and grid patterns; corrected custom colors.
Improved wind and player/mob contact bending.

fixed.title: No Ads
items: Handles the known English Skip AD dialog and mutes recognized ad media.

added.title: New features
items: Added automatic update downloads while the launcher is idle and installation when it closes.
Existing users install this version once; future releases no longer need manual downloads.

added.title: New features
items: Connected built-in shaders to Bloxd native shadows, with separate block and entity switches, strength and distance.
Integrated water, lava, fog, entity lighting, sky effects, Grassify and schematic previews with the native renderer.

added.title: New features
items: Changed shadow rendering and removed obsolete shadow-map controls.

added.title: New features
items: Added distinct block-cloud styles and refined cloud shapes and solar optics.

added.title: New features
items: Adjusted sun size and made flare reflections smaller and softer.

added.title: New features
items: Introduced volume clouds, sunlight through cloud openings and shared cloud shadows.

added.title: New features
items: Enlarged the sun and refined lens flare and cloud transmission.

added.title: New features
items: Added saved crash reports, a homepage notice, log copying and user-triggered support submission.

added.title: New features
items: Removed block and liquid reflections, retained leaf motion and simplified Bloxd lighting controls.

added.title: New features
items: Introduced revised cloud and liquid effects, GPU bloom and additional reflection controls.

added.title: New features
items: Added a finite character departure animation, improved profile selection and removed the character dust effect.
added.note: Introduction date not recorded; documented on November 13, 2026.

added.title: Profile identity and character effects
items: Choose from 50 profile icons and a custom icon color in profile settings.
Show your chosen icon in profile pictures, beside the Home profile name and in the profile content header.
Added subtle gold dust behind the 3D character that responds to character rotation.
The character and gold dust grow slightly on hover, with reduced-motion support.

added.title: Homepage and performance
items: Gold Bloxdy heading with selected profile details and direct edit/mod actions.
On-demand launcher RAM and CPU readings, profile memory budget, system RAM and diagnostic shortcuts.

added.title: Launcher redesign
items: Website-inspired black, cream and gold palette with Manrope typography and glass primary buttons.
Updated navigation, profiles, accounts, settings and mod browser.

added.title: Installation guide
items: Windows installation steps with screenshots at the bottom of this page.

added.title: Zoom text
items: Show percentage and multiplier separately, together, or hide both.
Adjust text size, X/Y position, and color. Uses the game font without a background.
Removed the visible-width display; added direct Windows downloads.

added.title: Linux preview
items: Experimental Ubuntu 26.04 x64 build with EZ Mods and an optional installer.
Standard renderer only; no Premium downloads, Windows memory limit, or autostart.

added.title: Zoomer controls
items: Adjust default/max zoom up to 100×, look speed, wheel steps, and separate in/out times.
Optional smooth wheel zoom with a 0–1 second transition.

added.title: Zoomer and Factory Buffer Reuse
items: Hold V to zoom and use the wheel to change magnification.
Factory Buffer Reuse avoids duplicate graphics uploads; FPS gains are unmeasured.

added.title: Grassify options
items: Flat, Round, and Realistic styles; color, thickness, distance, and wind controls.
5–1000 blades per block, height 0.1–3 blocks, with wind and player/mob bending.

added.title: Grassify
items: Optional grass with wind, color, distance, and contact controls.

added.title: Existing features
added.note: Existing features; original introduction dates are unknown.
items: Profiles with separate mods, settings, textures, and saved account sessions.
Memory presets and Windows RAM limits; Standard and experimental native renderers.
Launcher themes, Windows autostart, minimize-on-play, and performance measurements.
Automatic 3D character sync, homepage rotation, and account-head portraits.
Texture selection, pack downloads/library, and No Ads.
Litematica: schematic selection, import/export, library, previews, materials, layers, and placement tools. Currently unusable.
Shaders: shadows, sky, water/lava, fog, bloom, lighting, effects, presets, and custom shaders. Currently unusable.

bugs.title: Known limitations
items: Shaders and Litematica are experimental; visuals and compatibility are still being tested.

bugs.title: Known limitations
items: Shader visuals and mod compatibility still require in-game verification.

bugs.title: Known limitations
items: Later reported to cause severe lag and worse shadows; these changes were reverted in 1.8.0.

bugs.title: Shaders and Litematica
items: Both mods are currently unusable.
